chapterInfo.content:
9
Wɔnyi toɔ ansa na Paulo aba
1 # 2 Ko 8.4; 8.20 Na ɛfa ahotefoɔ som no ho deɛ, ɛnhia sɛ metwerɛ mo; 2#2 Ko 8.19 ɛfiri sɛ menim ɛho adwene a mowɔ a mede mehoahoa me ho mekyerɛ Makedoniafoɔ, sɛ Akaiafoɔ siesiee wɔn ho afe ni. Na mo mmɔdemmɔ no akɔkanyan nnipa bebree. 3#2 Ko 8.24 Nanso masoma anuanom yi, na yɛn ahohoahoa a yɛhoahoa no mo ho no anyɛ kwa, na sɛdeɛ mekaeɛ no, moasiesie mo ho, 4na sɛ Makedoniafoɔ bi ne me ba, na wɔbɛto mo sɛ monsiesiee mo ho a, yɛn mpo yɛn ani bɛwu — nyɛ mene mo mmom — sɛ yɛde yɛn ho too mo soɔ. 5Enti medwene sɛ ɛhia sɛ metu anuanom no foɔ sɛ wɔnni yɛn anim mmra mo nkyɛn na wɔmmɛsiesie mo nhyira a mahyɛ aseɛ masie no nto hɔ, na ada hɔ sɛ nhyira, na ɛnyɛ sɛ anibereɛ.
Deɛ yɛguo na yɛbɛtwa
6 # Mmb 11.24; 19.17 Na yei deɛ, deɛ ɔdua no kyenkyenee mu no bɛtwa no kyenkyenee mu, na deɛ ɔdua no bafuu no bɛtwa no bafuu. 7#Rom 12.8 Sɛdeɛ obiara asusu n’akoma mu no, ɔmma, ɛnyɛ amemenemfe anaa ɔhyɛ mu, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ ɔte n’anim ma no na Onyankopɔn dɔ no. 8Na Onyankopɔn bɛtumi sɛ ɔma adom nyinaa boro so ma mo, na nnoɔma nyinaa mu ne daa nyinaa moanya deɛ ɛdɔɔso ma mo nyinaa, na moaboro so adwuma pa nyinaa mu, 9#Dwom 112.9 sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Ɔto pete, ɔde ma ahiafoɔ,
ne tenenee no wɔ hɔ daa.
Ayamyɛ so aba
10 # Yes 55.10; Hos 10.12 Na deɛ ɔde aba ma ogufoɔ na ɔma paanoo sɛ aduane no, ɔbɛma aba a moguo no, na wama no adɔɔso, na wama mo tenenee aba no ase adɔre. 11#2 Ko 1.11; 4.15 Na moanya mo ho biribiara mu, ama ayamyɛ nyinaa a ɛnam yɛn so no ama Onyankopɔn anya aseda. 12#2 Ko 8.14 Ɛfiri sɛ ɔsom yi ho adwuma deɛ, ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔde bɛyɛ deɛ ɛhia ahotefoɔ no nko ara, na mmom ɛnam aseda bebree a wɔde da Onyankopɔn no so bɛboro so. 13Na wɔnam mo som a wɔhunu so, bɛhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam wɔ mo setie a mode ka Kristo asɛmpa no, ne mo ayamyɛ a mode boa wɔn ne nnipa nyinaa mu, 14na wɔn ara nso bɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama mo, na Nyankopɔn adom a aboro so agu mo soɔ no nti, wɔn ani bɛgyina mo. 15Na aseda nka Onyankopɔn wɔ n’akyɛdeɛ a ɛnni kabea no ho!

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɛfa ahotefoɔ som no ho deɛ, ɛnhia sɛ metwerɛ mo; ɛfiri sɛ menim ɛho adwene a mowɔ a mede mehoahoa me ho mekyerɛ Makedoniafoɔ, sɛ Akaiafoɔ siesiee wɔn ho afe ni. Na mo mmɔdemmɔ no akɔkanyan nnipa bebree. Nanso masoma anuanom yi, na yɛn ahohoahoa a yɛhoahoa no mo ho no anyɛ kwa, na sɛdeɛ mekaeɛ no, moasiesie mo ho, na sɛ Makedoniafoɔ bi ne me ba, na wɔbɛto mo sɛ monsiesiee mo ho a, yɛn mpo yɛn ani bɛwu — nyɛ mene mo mmom — sɛ yɛde yɛn ho too mo soɔ. Enti medwene sɛ ɛhia sɛ metu anuanom no foɔ sɛ wɔnni yɛn anim mmra mo nkyɛn na wɔmmɛsiesie mo nhyira a mahyɛ aseɛ masie no nto hɔ, na ada hɔ sɛ nhyira, na ɛnyɛ sɛ anibereɛ.

Na yei deɛ, deɛ ɔdua no kyenkyenee mu no bɛtwa no kyenkyenee mu, na deɛ ɔdua no bafuu no bɛtwa no bafuu. Sɛdeɛ obiara asusu n’akoma mu no, ɔmma, ɛnyɛ amemenemfe anaa ɔhyɛ mu, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ ɔte n’anim ma no na Onyankopɔn dɔ no. Na Onyankopɔn bɛtumi sɛ ɔma adom nyinaa boro so ma mo, na nnoɔma nyinaa mu ne daa nyinaa moanya deɛ ɛdɔɔso ma mo nyinaa, na moaboro so adwuma pa nyinaa mu, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Ɔto pete, ɔde ma ahiafoɔ,
ne tenenee no wɔ hɔ daa.


Na deɛ ɔde aba ma ogufoɔ na ɔma paanoo sɛ aduane no, ɔbɛma aba a moguo no, na wama no adɔɔso, na wama mo tenenee aba no ase adɔre. Na moanya mo ho biribiara mu, ama ayamyɛ nyinaa a ɛnam yɛn so no ama Onyankopɔn anya aseda. Ɛfiri sɛ ɔsom yi ho adwuma deɛ, ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔde bɛyɛ deɛ ɛhia ahotefoɔ no nko ara, na mmom ɛnam aseda bebree a wɔde da Onyankopɔn no so bɛboro so. Na wɔnam mo som a wɔhunu so, bɛhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam wɔ mo setie a mode ka Kristo asɛmpa no, ne mo ayamyɛ a mode boa wɔn ne nnipa nyinaa mu, na wɔn ara nso bɛbɔ mpaeɛ ama mo, na Nyankopɔn adom a aboro so agu mo soɔ no nti, wɔn ani bɛgyina mo. Na aseda nka Onyankopɔn wɔ n’akyɛdeɛ a ɛnni kabea no ho!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
